card.name: Linking words before combination drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "on", "when", "receiving" that come right before a combination product or contraceptive/antiretroviral therapy name. Also fires on the end of "contraceptives" in this setting.

modes.label: Component of a combination
modes.description: The word "of" after "a component" and before a combination product name.
modes.example: TAF, a component<< of>> ODEFSEY, is a substrate

modes.label: Link before contraceptives or therapy
modes.description: Words like "on", "when", "receiving" or "combination" leading into oral contraceptives, co-administration or antiretroviral therapy.
modes.example: no effect on pregnancy rates among HIV-infected women<< on>> combined oral contraceptives.
